commits.subject: Prove geometric generic flatness (Nitsure §4): over an integral locally noetherian base S, a finitely presented module sheaf on a finite-type X → S has flat sections over all affine pairs below a non-empty V = D(f). New file Picard/GenericFlatnessGeometric.lean: the mixed-base stability lemma Module.Flat.of_isLocalizedModule_algebra (flatness over the base survives localizing at a fibre-algebra submonoid — axiom-clean, closes a Mathlib gap), the chart-basic core (chart freeness at g localizes to any basic open above D(g), via the qcqs section-localization engine and base-ring descent), and the two-layer basic-open reduction via Module.flat_of_isLocalized_span plus two flat_iff_of_isLocalization exchanges. genericFlatness's own proof is complete and kernel-checked; it is conditional (sorryAx) only through genericFlatnessAlgebraic, whose r3 induction proof (session 0027, ended at rate limit, integrated unverified) fails the batch kernel build at three localized-module instance walls and is honestly re-opened as a documented typed sorry (r3 text preserved in ledger 6c30537; its sub-lemma layer survives kernel-checked). FlatteningStratification.lean stays Mathlib-only-imports so its heavy dévissage proofs keep their instance environment.
